name: SHIP-READY Phase 3 — G3 pageSheet grabber ink (the arbiter runs BEFORE any render)
_doc: PURPOSE: decide the grabber-pill ink for the three pageSheet surfaces (03 §3 G3) with the
contrast script, not the eye (PROTECT-5). 03 said 'reuse ui/Sheet's pill verbatim'; Phase 2
refused (J2-12) because that pill is color.borderStrong, which is declared in ZERO of the 19
existing proof sets and lands ~1.0-1.2 over glass. This set puts the shipped ink and two
candidates on the record together so Sky's mockup gate chooses among options that PASSED.
RUN: node /Users/skypie/AccessMap-material-lab/2026-07-02/shared/contrast-check.mjs design-reviews/ship-ready/tools/shipready-grabber-stacks.json
SURFACES: the three grabber surfaces are ResourcesScreen + HowToHelpScreen (both
GlassSurface variant=chrome, borderRadius 0, with a headerRow that has NO background of its
own -- the chrome material supplies it) and NearbyFlagsModal (variant=bulk). Nearby is the
correction Phase 2 made to 03 §7.1: its styles.header paints OPAQUE color.surface over the
bulk fill, so a grabber placed INSIDE that header lands on solid chrome and only one placed
ABOVE it lands on glass. That is the genuine per-surface fork, hence nearbySolidHeader below.
*Lite surfaces are the reduce-transparency variants -- both must clear the floor, since the
user can flip that switch at any time.
BACKDROP REALISM: bases are copied verbatim from the ratified wave1 proof set
(qa-reports/assets/2026-07-03_glass_w1/wave1-stacks.json) -- worst-case real backdrops, not
invented ones: #000 (dark map tiles / photo), #D92D20 (a sev-5 pin under the sheet), #0B3D8F
(deep brand field). Light and dark keep their own base sets.
FLOOR: min 3.0, matching the sibling close-X in the same component
(wave1-stacks.json:311-316 declares the close-X icon at min 3). HONEST NOTE: the grabber is
accessibilityElementsHidden and every one of these sheets also has a visible Close button, so
1.4.11 is arguable rather than certain here. 3.0 is the floor the HOUSE applies to sibling
chrome affordances; consistency is the argument, not a WCAG citation. Declared so no reviewer
has to guess which it is.
RESULT EXPECTED: the three borderStrong rows FAIL (that is the point -- it puts J2-12's number
on the record instead of in a report). inkGlassMuted is expected to pass everywhere with
margin; textSubtle is the lighter middle candidate and is the one genuinely in question.
closeXReference must reproduce the known-good shipped result -- if it does not, the manifest
is wrong, not the app.
